statement: Intel non-GAAP gross margin was 41.8% in Q2 2026, up 12.1 percentage points year over year and 2.8 points above guidance.
why: Sharply higher margins alongside higher revenue indicate pricing power and better factory loading rather than volume bought with discounts.

impact.mechanism: Margin expansion in a competitive silicon supplier signals demand is strong enough to absorb price, reinforcing the demand track.

evidence.source: Intel Newsroom / Intel Q2 2026 earnings release
evidence.excerpt: Non-GAAP gross margin: 41.8%, up 12.1 percentage points YoY and 2.8 points above guidance

confidence.basis: Earnings figures relayed through secondary coverage; primary filing returned an error and was not read.
